notes.title: New Version Release v1.32
notes.notes: [h3]We’ve greatly enhanced controls for both gamepads and VR controllers:[/h3][list][*][p]Actions that previously required multiple keys can now be executed with dedicated buttons.[/p][/*][*][p]Body type changes that required multiple keys can now be performed with a single dedicated button.[/p][/*][*][p]Rotation can now be controlled with the stick.[/p][/*][*][p]Movement and rotation stick inputs now support full analog control.[/p][/*][/list][p]With analog stick movement and rotation, fine adjustments are now much easier![/p][hr][/hr][h3]Display & UI Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]When key bindings change (such as in Direct Menu or panel operations), the corresponding keys are now displayed.[/p][/*][*][p]The “Normalization Gauge” for Dark Succubi is now always visible.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the transparency of the Slime body, making it easier to see objects hidden behind it.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Behavior & Stability Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Upgraded the game engine version for improved stability.[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced Succubus behavior control.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Other Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]Updated the manual.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor adjustments and refinements.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]These improvements are also applied to the Demo version—enjoy![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45667854/1d2567ff5a95939c812dfa85aa7fe82f3ebbc8a9.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45667854/9901336d08f3a3205cdf7a4414d001d816e70c04.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: New Version Release v1.22
notes.notes: [p]We’ve fixed an issue where players could pass through solid walls and other fixed objects.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]Other Improvements[/h3][p]Added new sound effects.[/p][hr][/hr][p]This fix is also applied to the Demo version—enjoy![/p]

notes.title: New Version Release v1.21
notes.notes: [h3]You can now use the non-designated VR controller to simplify certain actions.[/h3][hr][/hr][p]The VR controller was originally designed so you can play entirely with just one hand—but with two controllers, the experience becomes even smoother and more comfortable.[/p][p]Rotation can now be controlled with the stick on the second controller.[/p][p]The trigger on the second controller is bound to the Select Key, allowing you to operate without shifting your fingers.[/p][p]You can choose which controller (left or right) to use as the main one in the Options menu.[/p][p]For those with strong VR legs, you can now soar through space with ultra-acrobatic moves by rotating while moving![/p][hr][/hr][h3]Other Improvements[/h3][p]Updated the manual.[/p][p]Minor adjustments and refinements.[/p][hr][/hr][p]These improvements are also available in the Demo version—enjoy![/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45667854/907c0a0c1884c4fff9a012b68bf2a9512f0fc480.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: New Version Release v1.18
notes.notes: [h3]When a gamepad is connected during Standard Play, you can control the game with both the keyboard & mouse and the gamepad simultaneously.[/h3][p]Since rotation can now be controlled with dedicated keys, you can perform more complex actions—such as rotating while moving. For those who want to enjoy it as an action game, this is a great new option![/p][p]And now… you can also play on gaming handheld PCs![/p][p]Take your harem anywhere you go![/p][hr][/hr][h3]Other Improvements[/h3][p]Updated the manual.[/p][p]Minor adjustments and refinements.[/p][hr][/hr][p]These improvements are also available in the Demo version—enjoy![/p][hr][/hr][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45667854/dcfaa45cbc1618c9f330bd197e7470dc47e59bca.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: New Version Release v1.12
notes.notes: [h3]We’ve simplified the process of connecting the Slime to the Succubus.[/h3][h3]Now, by transforming into a Connection Body and making contact, the connection happens automatically.[/h3][olist][*][p]Press the Sub Key (Right Click), then hold the Main Key (Left Click) and press the Select Key (Space) to transform the Slime into the Connection Body.[/p][/*][*][p]In this form, simply touch the Succubus’s head, chest, or waist to connect automatically. The connection will be released when you move away, but since the Slime remains in Connection Body form, you can reconnect easily just by touching again. (You can check whether you’re connected by looking at the white sphere in front of the body.)[/p][/*][*][p]While connected, if you touch another Succubus, the Slime will connect to her as well. This allows you to stimulate multiple Succubi at the same time.[/p][/*][*][p]To stop automatic connections, repeat the same key input to return the Slime to its normal body.[/p][/*][/olist][hr][/hr][h3]Crystal generation, which was often mis-triggered with rotation, now requires a key hold to activate.[/h3][p]An effect will appear while charging. If you don’t want to generate, perform another key input at this point to cancel the generation.[/p][hr][/hr][h3]Other Improvements[/h3][p]Manual updated.[/p][p]New sound effects added.[/p][p]Minor adjustments and balancing.[/p][hr][/hr][p]These improvements are also available in the Demo version—enjoy![/p]
